<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>א.ב. פתרונות מיזוג | תיקון והתקנת מזגנים בקריית ביאליק – 24/7</title>
  <meta name="description" content="א.ב. פתרונות מיזוג – שירות מקצועי לתיקון, התקנה וניקיון מזגנים בקריית ביאליק. זמין ראשון–שישי 24 שעות. 052-317-2392"/>
  <meta name="keywords" content="תיקון מזגן קריית ביאליק, התקנת מזגן, ניקוי מזגן, שירות מזגנים, א.ב. פתרונות מיזוג"/>
  <meta name="robots" content="index, follow"/>
  <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"HVACBusiness","name":"א.ב. פתרונות מיזוג","telephone":"+972-52-317-2392","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","streetAddress":"גיורא 10","addressLocality":"קריית ביאליק","postalCode":"2708222","addressCountry":"IL"},"openingHoursSpecification":[{"@type":"OpeningHoursSpecification","dayOfWeek":["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"],"opens":"00:00","closes":"23:59"}],"aggregateRating":{"@type":"AggregateRating","ratingValue":"5","reviewCount":"3"}}</script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Heebo:wght@300;400;500;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <style>
    :root{--bg:#040C1E;--bg2:#071528;--surf:#0C1D3A;--fire:#2563EB;--ice:#60A5FA;--white:#FFFFFF;--muted:rgba(255,255,255,.45);--border:rgba(96,165,250,.1);--ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--ease2:cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{font-family:'Heebo',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.65;cursor:none}
    a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
    img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

    /* CURSOR */
    .cur{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;top:0;left:0;mix-blend-mode:difference}
    .cur-dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--white);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
    .cur-ring{width:36px;height:36px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .3s var(--ease),height .3s var(--ease)}
    body:has(a:hover) .cur-ring,body:has(button:hover) .cur-ring{width:56px;height:56px}

    /* PROGRESS BAR */
    #pgbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--fire),var(--ice));transform-origin:right;transform:scaleX(0);z-index:1000;transition:transform .05s linear}

    /* NAV */
    nav{position:fixed;top:0;inset-inline:0;z-index:900;padding:22px 0;transition:background .4s,padding .4s,box-shadow .4s}
    nav.solid{background:rgba(7,8,15,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);padding:13px 0;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--border)}
    .nav-in{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
    .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15}
    .brand strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--white)}
    .brand small{font-size:11px;color:var(--ice);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em}
    .nav-links{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none}
    .nav-links a{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;transition:color .2s}
    .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--white)}
    .nav-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563EB,#1D4ED8);color:var(--white);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:100px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
    .nav-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(37,99,235,.55)}

    /* HERO */
    .hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:55% 45%;min-height:100svh;position:relative}
    .hero-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:140px 72px 72px;background:var(--bg);position:relative;z-index:2}
    .hero-left::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-1px;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,var(--ice) 40%,var(--fire) 70%,transparent);opacity:.4}
    .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:32px;opacity:0;animation:fadeSlide .8s .1s var(--ease) both}
    .edot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fire);animation:blink 2s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.2}}
    .eyebrow span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
    .hero h1{font-size:clamp(48px,5.5vw,82px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:28px}
    .hl{display:block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(44px);filter:blur(6px);animation:lineUp 1s var(--ease) both}
    .hl:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.2s}.hl:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.4s}.hl:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.6s}
    .hl em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ice)}
    @keyframes lineUp{to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}}
    .hero-sub{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);max-width:400px;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:44px;opacity:0;animation:fadeSlide .8s .7s var(--ease) both}
    @keyframes fadeSlide{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
    .hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:16px;opacity:0;animation:fadeSlide .8s .85s var(--ease) both}
    .btn-fire{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563EB,#1D4ED8);color:var(--white);font-size:17px;font-weight:800;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:100px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease);font-family:inherit;border:none;cursor:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .btn-fire::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.18) 50%,transparent 60%);transform:translateX(-120%);transition:transform .55s var(--ease)}
    .btn-fire:hover::after{transform:translateX(120%)}
    .btn-fire:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(37,99,235,.6)}
    .btn-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);transition:border-color .25s,color .25s,background .25s;font-family:inherit;cursor:none}
    .btn-outline:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
    .hero-trust{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:36px;opacity:0;animation:fadeSlide .8s 1s var(--ease) both}
    .stars-gold{color:#FBBF24;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2px}
    .hero-trust span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
    .hero-right{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .hero-right::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to left,transparent 60%,var(--bg) 100%);z-index:1}
    #hphoto{position:absolute;inset:-20%;will-change:transform}
    #hphoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
    .scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:32px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:bob 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:2}
    @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px)}}
    .scroll-line{width:1px;height:40px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.3))}

    /* TICKER */
    .ticker{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1D4ED8,#2563EB,#3B82F6,#2563EB,#1D4ED8);background-size:300% 100%;animation:tickergrad 6s linear infinite;padding:14px 0;overflow:hidden;z-index:3;position:relative}
    @keyframes tickergrad{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
    .ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:scroll-left 22s linear infinite}
    .ticker-track:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
    .tick-item{white-space:nowrap;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);padding:0 20px;letter-spacing:.04em}
    .tick-sep{opacity:.5;margin:0 2px}
    @keyframes scroll-left{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

    /* SERVICES */
    .services{padding:120px 0;background:var(--white)}
    .sec-head{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px 64px}
    .lbl{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:18px}
    .lbl-fire{color:var(--fire);background:rgba(37,99,235,.1)}
    .lbl-ice{color:var(--ice);background:rgba(56,189,248,.1)}
    .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;color:#07080F}
    .svc-list{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
    .svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 44px;align-items:center;gap:32px;padding:36px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #E5EAF0;cursor:default;transition:background .3s,padding .3s,margin .3s}
    .svc:first-child{border-top:1px solid #E5EAF0}
    .svc:hover{background:#F8FAFF;margin:0 -40px;padding-inline:40px}
    .svc-n{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#94A3B8}
    .svc-body h3{font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);font-weight:800;color:#07080F;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.2}
    .svc-body p{font-size:15px;color:#64748B;max-width:580px;line-height:1.7}
    .svc-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
    .svc-tag{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#0F52A0;background:rgba(15,82,160,.08);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:100px}
    .svc-arr{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #CBD5E1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#94A3B8;flex-shrink:0;transition:all .3s;transform:rotate(180deg)}
    .svc:hover .svc-arr{border-color:var(--fire);background:var(--fire);color:var(--white)}

    /* GALLERY */
    .gallery{padding:120px 0;background:var(--bg2)}
    .gallery .wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
    .gallery h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;margin-top:16px;margin-bottom:56px}
    .g-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:300px 260px;gap:14px}
    .gitem{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surf)}
    .gitem.gmain{grid-row:1/3}
    .gitem img{transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
    .gitem:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
    .gcap{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:20px 22px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(7,8,15,.85));color:var(--white);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}
    .gitem:hover .gcap{opacity:1;transform:none}
    .g-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:28px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
    .g-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border)}

    /* NUMBERS */
    .numbers{background:var(--bg)}
    .num-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
    .num-cell{padding:72px 48px;border-left:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
    .num-cell::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ice),var(--fire));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:right;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
    .num-cell:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
    .num-cell:hover{background:rgba(37,99,235,.04)}
    .num-val{font-size:clamp(52px,6vw,80px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:8px}
    .num-val .suf{font-size:.5em;color:var(--fire)}
    .num-label{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}

    /* REVIEWS */
    .reviews{padding:120px 0;background:var(--bg2)}
    .reviews .wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
    .rev-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;margin-bottom:56px}
    .rev-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.5vw,48px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;margin-top:16px}
    .gscore{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 24px}
    .gscore .big{font-size:44px;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
    .gscore .sg{display:block;color:#FBBF24;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px}
    .gscore .glab{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
    .rev-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
    .rcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:30px;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,transform .35s var(--ease)}
    .rcard:hover{background:rgba(37,99,235,.08);border-color:rgba(96,165,250,.35);transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(37,99,235,.2)}
    .rstars{color:#FBBF24;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:18px;letter-spacing:2px}
    .rtext{font-size:15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);line-height:1.8;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:24px;position:relative;padding-right:8px}
    .rtext::before{content:'\201C';position:absolute;top:-12px;right:-4px;font-size:52px;color:var(--fire);opacity:.2;font-style:normal;line-height:1}
    .rauth{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
    .rav{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0F52A0,#38BDF8);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
    .rname{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
    .rmeta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}

    /* FAQ */
    .faq{padding:120px 0;background:var(--bg)}
    .faq-wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.8fr;gap:100px;align-items:start}
    .faq-left{position:sticky;top:120px}
    .faq-left h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,42px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;margin:16px 0 18px}
    .faq-left p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:32px}
    .faq-items{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
    .fitem{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s}
    .fitem.open{border-color:rgba(37,99,235,.4)}
    .fbtn{width:100%;text-align:right;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border:none;padding:20px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);cursor:none;font-family:inherit;transition:background .25s}
    .fbtn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
    .ficon{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .35s var(--ease),background .3s}
    .fitem.open .ficon{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--fire)}
    .fbody{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s var(--ease2)}
    .fitem.open .fbody{max-height:200px}
    .fbody-in{padding:0 24px 20px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}

    /* BIG CTA */
    .bigcta{position:relative;min-height:80vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
    .bigcta-bg{position:absolute;inset:0}
    .bigcta-bg img{opacity:.2;filter:blur(2px);transform:scale(1.08)}
    .bigcta-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(4,12,30,.97),rgba(7,21,40,.82))}
    .bigcta-body{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:0 40px;max-width:760px}
    .bigcta-body h2{font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,88px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:12px}
    .bigcta-body h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--fire)}
    .bigcta-body .sub{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:48px}
    .phone-big{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563EB,#1D4ED8);color:var(--white);font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,34px);font-weight:900;padding:22px 52px;border-radius:100px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s var(--ease);font-family:inherit;border:none;cursor:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .phone-big::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.18) 50%,transparent 60%);transform:translateX(-130%);transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
    .phone-big:hover::after{transform:translateX(130%)}
    .phone-big:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 22px 56px rgba(37,99,235,.65)}
    .cta-note{margin-top:24px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);letter-spacing:.06em}

    /* FOOTER */
    footer{background:#040509;padding:36px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
    .foot-in{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px}
    .foot-in p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
    .foot-nav{display:flex;gap:24px}
    .foot-nav a{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);transition:color .2s}
    .foot-nav a:hover{color:var(--ice)}

    /* FLOATING RING */
    .ring{position:fixed;bottom:28px;left:28px;z-index:800;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--fire);color:var(--white);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:100px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(37,99,235,.5);animation:ringpulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes ringpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(37,99,235,.5),0 0 0 0 rgba(37,99,235,.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 8px 48px rgba(37,99,235,.9),0 0 0 10px rgba(37,99,235,0)}}
    .ring svg{animation:wiggly 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes wiggly{0%,60%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}10%,30%{transform:rotate(-15deg)}20%,40%{transform:rotate(15deg)}}

    /* REVEALS */
    [data-r]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(36px);filter:blur(8px);transition:opacity .85s var(--ease),transform .85s var(--ease),filter .85s var(--ease)}
    [data-r="l"]{transform:translateX(36px);filter:blur(8px)}[data-r="r"]{transform:translateX(-36px);filter:blur(8px)}
    [data-r].on{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}
    [data-d="1"]{transition-delay:.12s}[data-d="2"]{transition-delay:.24s}[data-d="3"]{transition-delay:.36s}

    /* RESPONSIVE */
    @media(max-width:1024px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto}.hero-right{height:60vw}#hphoto{inset:0}.hero-left{padding:100px 32px 56px}.nav-links{display:none}.num-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.rev-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.faq-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}.faq-left{position:static}.svc{grid-template-columns:80px 1fr}.svc-arr{display:none}.g-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto}.gitem.gmain,.gitem{grid-row:auto;height:260px}}
    @media(max-width:640px){.hero-left,.sec-head,.svc-list,.gallery .wrap,.reviews .wrap,.faq-wrap{padding-inline:24px}.num-cell{padding:48px 28px}.bigcta-body{padding:0 24px}.ring span{display:none}.ring{padding:15px;border-radius:50%}.foot-in{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}.nav-in{padding:0 24px}.hero-actions{flex-direction:column}.btn-fire,.btn-outline{width:100%;justify-content:center}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="cur" id="cd"><div class="cur-dot"></div></div>
<div class="cur" id="cr"><div class="cur-ring"></div></div>
<div id="pgbar"></div>

<nav id="nav">
  <div class="nav-in">
    <a href="#hero" class="brand"><strong>א.ב. פתרונות מיזוג</strong><small>קריית ביאליק · פתוח 24/7</small></a>
    <ul class="nav-links">
      <li><a href="#services">שירותים</a></li>
      <li><a href="#gallery">עבודות</a></li>
      <li><a href="#reviews">ביקורות</a></li>

<script>
  // Custom cursor
  const cd=document.getElementById('cd'),cr=document.getElementById('cr');
  let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
  document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cd.style.transform=`translate(${mx}px,${my}px)`;});
  (function a(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.12;ry+=(my-ry)*.12;cr.style.transform=`translate(${rx}px,${ry}px)`;requestAnimationFrame(a);})();
  // Progress bar
  const pb=document.getElementById('pgbar');
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>{const m=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;pb.style.transform=`scaleX(${m>0?scrollY/m:0})`;},{passive:true});
  // Nav
  const nav=document.getElementById('nav');
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>nav.classList.toggle('solid',scrollY>60),{passive:true});
  // Parallax hero
  const hp=document.getElementById('hphoto');
  addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(hp)hp.style.transform=`translateY(${scrollY*.28}px)`;},{passive:true});
  // Reveals
  const ro=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('on');ro.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:0.1,rootMargin:'0px 0px -32px 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-r]').forEach(el=>ro.observe(el));
  // Counters
  function cu(el,to,ms=1800){let s;const f=t=>{if(!s)s=t;const p=Math.min((t-s)/ms,1);el.textContent=Math.round((1-Math.pow(1-p,3))*to);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);};requestAnimationFrame(f);}
  const co=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){cu(e.target,+e.target.dataset.count);co.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.6});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el=>co.observe(el));
  // FAQ
  document.querySelectorAll('.fbtn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const i=b.closest('.fitem'),o=i.classList.contains('open');document.querySelectorAll('.fitem.open').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('open'));if(!o)i.classList.add('open');}));
  // Magnetic
  document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic').forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();el.style.transform=`translate(${(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.3}px,${(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.3}px)`;});el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>el.style.transform='');});
  // Smooth scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));if(t){e.preventDefault();t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});}}));
</script>
